section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the literature on body appreciation and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), discussing its development, psychometric properties, and limitations. The authors note that the BAS has been widely used to study positive body image in Western countries, but has several limitations including weak item-factor loadings in non-Western samples and outdated item wording. The section concludes by stating that the authors developed a revised version called BAS-2 and conducted three studies to determine whether the BAS-2 is a psychometrically sound measure.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire introduction section provides this context, with the key statement: 'We conducted three studies to determine whether the BAS-2 could be a psychometrically sound measure used to guide this research.'
